$comment: Canonical viewport matrix (BROWSER-REGRESSION-QA-PROTOCOL.md sec 6). A project may narrow or extend this in its browser-qa-manifest.json, but every project MUST cover one width in each class.
notes: The required smoke matrix runs on every build and on every reopened build.
The extended regression matrix runs before Gauntlet entry, before production pre-flight, and on any change to layout, tokens, IA, or motion.

Do not run every assertion at every width when it multiplies cost without signal: responsive invariants and screenshots run across the full class set; measurement, console, network, and form assertions run on the smoke matrix unless a route is viewport-conditional.
